cobblemon.ability.drama.desc: Its yawns are double: Yawn hits every adjacent foe and the sleep it causes lasts twice as long.

emi_plush.species.gatitoalien.desc: The official mascot of Emi's channel. Extremely loud and dramatic: it meows at everything, faints over nothing, and yawns so theatrically that the sleepiness spreads.

emi_plush.species.gatitoalien_gold.desc: Dipped in solid gold. Hard to move, harder to hurt, and whatever touches it comes away sticky and slow.
emi_plush.species.gatitoalien_sunglasses: It never takes the shades off, not even to nap. It hits first, hits hard and always knows where you are.
Always on vacation. Give it sun or a little rain and it recovers while it splashes the whole opposing team.
emi_plush.species.gatitoalien_crown.desc: The self-proclaimed king of the channel. It endures anything with its head held high and listens to no one.
emi_plush.species.gatitoalien_bow.desc: Its bow is a gift to everyone near it. Whoever stands next to it feels better in a few turns.
emi_plush.species.gatitoalien_headphones: Its music is so loud the air crackles. Every shout it lets out comes with lightning.
emi_plush.species.gatitoalien_scarf.desc: Wrapped up in its scarf, cold and fire are the same to it. It tackles blizzards and bonfires with the same yawn.
emi_plush.species.gatitoalien_halo.desc: A little glow floats over its antennas. Curses slide off it and wounds close before the next turn.
emi_plush.species.gatitoalien_devil_horn: It signed something it should not have. It burns with power, but the deal is not cheap.
Its brews are always one ailment away from a disaster. If you are already sick, it hits much harder.
It sees who has been good and who has been dramatic. Every few turns it leaves a surprise gift of power.
emi_plush.species.gatitoalien_flower_cro: Flowers grow back on its crown as fast as you pluck them. It shrugs off pollen, spores and most of your attacks.
emi_plush.species.gatitoalien_pirate.des: Each rival it defeats is another chest for its treasure. It comes out of every fight stronger and in a better mood.
item.emi_plush.ticket_gasha_michi.desc: Right click: 1 pull. Sneak: up to 10 at once.
item.emi_plush.ticket_gasha_michi.desc2: Every 10th pull without a pair gives a Pokemon with its plush.
cobblemon.ability.toquedemidas.desc: Attackers that make contact lose 1 Speed (sticky gold). It raises its own Defense by 1 on entry.
cobblemon.ability.gafaschulas.desc: Critical hits +1 stage, its accuracy cannot be lowered, and its moves ignore the target's evasion.
cobblemon.ability.dadeplaya.desc: Water-type moves are 30% stronger, and under sun or rain it restores 1/16 of its HP every turn.
cobblemon.ability.soberano.desc: Takes 25% less damage at full HP. Immune to Taunt, Torment and Encore.
cobblemon.ability.cario.desc: At the end of every turn it restores 1/16 of the HP of itself and of its allies.
cobblemon.ability.ritmoelctrico.desc: Its sound-based moves become Electric type and are 20% stronger.
cobblemon.ability.abrigo.desc: Fire and Ice moves deal half damage to it, and it cannot be burned or frozen.
cobblemon.ability.bendicin.desc: Each turn it cures its own status condition. Dark and Ghost moves deal half damage to it.
cobblemon.ability.pactoinfernal.desc: Its damaging moves are 30% stronger, but every attack costs it 1/10 of its max HP.
cobblemon.ability.maleficio.desc: Its moves deal 40% more damage to targets that have a status condition.
cobblemon.ability.lluviaderegalos.desc: At the end of each turn it has a 1 in 3 chance of raising a random stat by 1 stage.
cobblemon.ability.floracin.desc: It restores 1/16 of its HP every turn (1/8 under harsh sunlight) and is immune to powder and spore moves.
cobblemon.ability.saqueo.desc: When it knocks out a Pokémon it raises its Attack by 1 stage and restores 1/4 of its max HP.
